detail:
New decision "Chose to always render 'volatile: yes|no' (not only when true) so absent and false stay distinguishable, and to render the observation body's base/head on the observed line while scope.revision renders on the scope line, both as 8-hex base..head with one side allowed absent (..head, base..)" relates to:
- 01M2KMTDSKBZSCCP3KRGF6G7FH: "Accepted deriving the working-set session cursor solely from the versions of records actually emitted (no store.events() scan), so the cursor cannot advance while any selected record remains budget-omitted"
- 01M2M0CYJX5B15YNXQTSFJPZKV: "Every event minted through the adapter runtime now cites this replica's current membership as a causal parent, via a new EventStore.currentPolicyEvent()"
- 01M2M0CYNH8H4ZVX49ZXKZCA37: "Fixed the lane-04 acceptance fixtures to link the policy rather than relaxing the admission rule, adding citeParents()/deliverUnderPolicy() to the slice harness"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 3 existing decision(s) overlap
